# Mintrix Trading

> Mintrix Trading is a UAE-registered, Dubai-based global food trading and procurement company. We source agricultural commodities and foodstuffs from verified suppliers worldwide, verify quality at origin, and deliver bulk orders with full export documentation (Halal, FDA, Certificate of Origin, phytosanitary) to buyers in 14+ countries.

Key facts: trading since 2016 · $50M+ trade executed · 2,000 MT monthly sourcing capacity · sourcing from 50+ countries · delivering to 14 countries · 24-hour quotation response · based in Deira, Dubai, UAE.

We supply restaurants, supermarkets, hotels, distributors, importers and wholesalers across 10 bulk food categories, from grains and spices to fresh produce and frozen poultry. Every shipment is quality-verified at origin and accompanied by complete export documentation; multiple product categories can be consolidated into a single container to reduce freight cost.
